notes.unproven: minted, no merkle path — stock gate keeps it out of serve() unless the kind admits zero-conf ancestry
notes.anchored: unproven but admissible: parent proven or BUMP-terminated ancestry — serves zero-conf lanes
notes.proven: carries a BUMP — quiescent, NOT terminal: a reorg demotes it back to unproven and the proving pass re-anchors
notes.dead: parent died / evicted — can never prove; named so unproven() stops gating on it
notes.guards: proof transitions require a real merkle path; anchor requires verified ancestry — a status hint promotes nothing
